name: api_health
title: Check liveness
description: Whether the service is up. It touches nothing, so it answers even while a backend is down.

name: api_status
title: Check readiness
description: Whether the service is ready, and every provider's verdict: its name, whether a ready service needs it, whether it answers, how long it took (ms) and why not. Ready means every required provider answers.

name: api_user_create
title: Create a user
description: Create a user record; the password is hashed and never returned. Returns the record. Needs the admin's key.

name: api_user_delete
title: Delete a user
description: Delete a user record by `user_id`; one already gone is no error. Needs the admin's key.

name: api_user_list
title: List users
description: Every user record: id, username, email, birth, quota, created. Needs an account's key.

name: api_user_read
title: Read a user
description: One user record by `user_id`. Needs an account's key.

name: api_user_update
title: Update a user
description: Change a user record by `user_id`: a field left out stays, `null` sets it to null. Returns the record. Needs the admin's key.

name: doc_convert
title: Convert a document to Markdown
description: Any document (PDF, Office, HTML, images, EPUB…) under the vault or the workspaces, by `path`, read into Markdown: tables as tables, scans read, pages in order. No model reads it — the engines do. Returns `name` and `markdown`.
